semiconductor_relevance: High — Mitsui Chemicals provides essential materials used in semiconductor manufacturing processes, such as protective tapes and high-performance chemical materials.
summary: Mitsui Chemicals Group is a key supplier of advanced materials and chemical solutions for semiconductor manufacturing. Their products, including ICROS™ Tape and ultra-high heat-resistant release films, are critical for processes like wafer grinding and filtration, supporting the industry's demand for innovative and reliable materials.
capabilities: ICROS™ Tape for backside wafer grinding
High-performance chemical materials for polishing pads and adhesives
